content: HL7 reference: an ADT A01 event signals a patient admission and carries the visit number, admitting provider and bed assignment.
HL7 reference: an ORU R01 observation result message carries segments for the ordering provider, the specimen and the result values.
FHIR reference: an Observation resource links a subject, a code and a value, and large payloads should be paginated with bundles.
FHIR reference: the Transaction interaction posts a bundle of create and update entries that must commit atomically or not at all.
Our FHIR ingest silently drops Observation bundles over 1 MB because the load balancer body limit is 1 MB.
I am locum cover at the Estarreja clinic this Friday only, 2026-05-15.

The FHIR ingest writes decoded batches into the clinical_lake schema.

I report to the Head of Data, Ines Cardoso.
Ines Cardoso's team owns the analytics licence budget for the year.
Lab result reconciliation runs at 05:00 Europe/Lisbon and normally finishes in 25 minutes.
Patient matching uses the national identifier first and falls back to a fuzzy name and dob score above 0.92.
We keep pseudonymised extracts only in the analytics project; identified data never leaves clinical_lake.
General practice feeds arrive over the NHS spines proxy once per hour.
Consent state is checked before every release to a third-party researcher, no exceptions.
Warehouse costs are reported monthly to the finance partner using the snowflake_usage view.
The staging tenant is named fernwood-qa and it replays last week's traffic.
Dashboards for ingest backlog live in the Data Reliability Grafana folder.
Python data jobs pin pandas 2.2 and use polars only for the reconciliation join.
The dedupe job caps at 8 worker processes because the container is limited to 8 GB.
Referral letters are parsed by the Textractor service and failures land in the dlq_referrals queue.
I keep a shared calendar called Fernwood Handover for shift notes.
Clinical data quality review meeting is every second Thursday at 14:00.
Postmortems for data incidents go in the clinical-data-runbooks repository.
Spine proxy credentials rotate monthly through the vault rotation job.
I use pgbouncer in transaction mode for all analytics connections.
